flags.issueFull: A charged special on a unit that has ended its turn doesn't open the special row. §3 says every tap on a charged special opens the row. Once a unit has ended its turn, or may only Evade, the engine gives it no options: it can neither fire nor warm up. Built so the button keeps its gold Charged look and a tap shows the reason in the dark pill ("Ended its turn") instead of opening a row where nothing works

flags.name: F026-1
flags.issue: The special sheet can miss a parry in an Arc Hit. The engine's specialPreview names only the first braced Heavy Melee hit in the arc. When that unit is killed (so it can't parry, parryNeedsSurvivor) but a second braced Heavy Melee in the arc survives, the engine lets the second one parry. The sheet…
flags.issueFull: The special sheet can miss a parry in an Arc Hit. The engine's specialPreview names only the first braced Heavy Melee hit in the arc. When that unit is killed (so it can't parry, parryNeedsSurvivor) but a second braced Heavy Melee in the arc survives, the engine lets the second one parry. The sheet then shows no parry while the attacker takes it. Example: newest preset, North Heavy Melee charged on C11, braced South Heavy Melee on C12 at 1 HP, braced South Heavy Melee 2 on B11: Arc Hit on C12 kills it, Heavy Melee 2 parries for 2, the sheet shows nothing. Rare (two braced Heavy Melee in one arc, the first killed). Brief 026 restyles and computes nothing new, so not fixed here. Fixing it means changing what specialPreview returns (display only, no rule). The bot never reads .parry (checked bot.js and brain.js), so the fix can't change any replay
flags.next: Recommendation: a ZZ build that makes specialPreview.parry follow doSpecial's own parry loop (the first braced Heavy Melee that survives its hit), with a test on this position and the replay hashes

flags.next: Suggested: a "home guard" weight (value of a unit standing in its own goal zone while the enemy can reach it), screened after the confirm

The cancelled run filed 30% of the games (6 of 20 parts) and moved all three job orders to studies/done/. The lab's paths filter doesn't protect a pull request: GitHub checks it against everything the pull request changes, so every push to a pull request with a job order or a version change restarts the lab. Code re-queued the orders (the partial run folders stay as filed, marked Failed) and pushes nothing more until they finish
flags.next: Recommended: the lab fix brief F022-7 asks for also skips the cancel when the new push changes nothing under studies/queue/, board/ or sims/lab/
